stories.name_fr: Investissement pour la fiabilité des actifs
stories.explanation: Programme de fiabilité des actifs de production.
stories.story_fr: Mosaic investit 100 millions de dollars pour renforcer la fiabilité de ses actifs.
stories.story_en: Mosaic is investing $100 million to enhance asset reliability.
stories.citation: Mosaic is Investing $100 Million to Enhance Asset Reliability

stories.explanation: Gains issus des améliorations de production et de coûts.
stories.story_fr: Mosaic vise plus de 650 millions de dollars de hausse d’EBITDA ajusté d’ici 2027 grâce aux améliorations de production et de coûts.
stories.story_en: Mosaic targets more than $650 million of adjusted EBITDA uplift by 2027 from production and cost improvements.
stories.citation: Production and Cost Improvements Can Lead to $650+ Million Adjusted EBITDA Uplift by 2027

stories.name_fr: Hausse d’EBITDA ajusté visée à 2030 (accès au marché)
stories.name_en: Adjusted EBITDA uplift outlook by 2030 (market access)
stories.explanation: Distribution, performance products et croissance au Brésil, en Chine et en Inde.
stories.story_fr: Mosaic vise environ 300 millions de dollars de hausse d’EBITDA ajusté d’ici 2030 grâce à ses objectifs d’accès au marché.
stories.story_en: Mosaic targets about $300 million of adjusted EBITDA uplift by 2030 from its market access initiatives.
stories.citation: Market Access Targets ~$300 Million Adjusted EBITDA Uplift by 2030

stories.name_fr: Hausse d’EBITDA ajusté visée en 5 ans
stories.name_en: Adjusted EBITDA improvement outlook over 5 years
stories.story_fr: Mosaic vise une amélioration d’environ 55 % de son EBITDA ajusté en 5 ans, à prix 2024 constants.
stories.story_en: Mosaic targets an improvement of about 55% in adjusted EBITDA in 5 years, assuming flat 2024 prices.
stories.citation: Our Path to Improving Adjusted EBITDA by ~55% in 5 years

stories.story_fr: Mosaic poursuit 2 à 3 milliards de dollars d’opportunités de réallocation de capital.
stories.story_en: Mosaic is pursuing $2 to $3 billion of capital reallocation opportunities.
stories.citation: We Are Pursuing $2 - $3 Billion of Reallocation Opportunities

stories.name_fr: Amélioration d’EBITDA ajusté attendue du programme numérique
stories.name_en: Adjusted EBITDA improvement expected from digital program
stories.story_fr: Mosaic attend plus de 70 millions de dollars d’amélioration d’EBITDA ajusté de son programme d’accélération numérique.
stories.story_en: Mosaic expects more than $70 million of adjusted EBITDA improvement from its global digital acceleration program.
stories.citation: Mosaic Implemented an Ambitious Global Digital Acceleration Program with Expectation of $70+ Million Adjusted EBITDA Improvement
